enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping (night owl, late bedtime); air conditioner running for the heatwave night
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up to chin. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Kicks off blanket. Pulls blanket back. Snores lightly. Opens eyes briefly. Looks at clock. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Remains still. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up slowly and completing daily stretching routine on the floor mat
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up in bed. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to floor mat. Unrolls mat. Does forward bend. Does arm stretch. Does neck stretch. Rolls up mat. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing with hot water, brushing teeth (Bathroom free after Member 1's 06:30-07:00 wash)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses body. Turns off water. Steps out. Dries with towel. Brushes teeth. Turns off light and walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a diet-restriction-friendly breakfast and brewing strong coffee with the kettle (after Member 1 has finished breakfast and left for work)
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Places ingredients on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out pan. Places pan on induction cooker. Turns on induction cooker. Adds oil to pan. Cracks eggs into pan. Stirs eggs. Turns off induction cooker. Takes kettle. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Waits for water to boil. Pours water over coffee grounds in French press. Presses plunger. Pours coffee into mug. Places pan on plate. Carries plate and mug to table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast while reading scripture and journaling devotional notes
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats eggs. Takes sip of coffee. Opens scripture book. Reads. Picks up pen. Writes in journal. Reads more. Writes more notes. Finishes meal. Closes book and journal.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up desk lamp and monitor, reviewing client files and the day's telehealth schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to study. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on monitor. Opens laptop. Logs in. Opens client files. Flips through pages. Checks schedule on screen. Makes notes. Closes files.

enriched_activities.activity: Conducting remote telehealth therapy sessions and writing clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Puts on headset. Opens video call software. Greets client. Listens. Nods. Takes notes. Types on keyboard. Speaks. Ends call. Writes clinical notes. Opens next client file. Starts next video call. Greets new client. Listens. Nods. Takes notes. Types. Speaks. Ends call. Writes more notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a simple lunch that respects the medical dietary restriction
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Cooks. Turns off cooker. Transfers food to plate. Sits at table. Eats. Drinks water. Cleans plate. Washes dishes. Dries hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting indoors away from the heatwave, doing light stretching and eye rest
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Closes eyes. Rubs eyes. Does neck stretch. Does shoulder stretch. Opens eyes. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Refilling water bottle and making another coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Takes water bottle. Fills from tap. Closes bottle. Takes coffee pod. Places in coffee machine. Presses button. Waits. Takes cup. Adds sugar. Stirs.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon telehealth consultations, case notes, and preparation for clinical supervision
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Reviews case notes. Opens video call software. Starts consultation. Greets client. Listens. Nods. Takes notes. Types on keyboard. Speaks. Ends call. Writes case notes. Opens supervision materials. Reads. Highlights text. Makes notes. Closes materials.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living area, vacuuming, and playing quiet music in the background
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Picks up items from floor. Places items in basket. Takes vacuum cleaner. Plugs in vacuum. Turns on vacuum. Vacuums floor. Turns off vacuum. Unplugs vacuum. Puts vacuum away. Turns on music player. Selects playlist. Adjusts volume. Sits on sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner from scratch using the induction cooker and rice cooker; Member 1 joins at 18:00 to help with cooking dinner (joint activity)
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Turns on rice cooker. Adds rice and water. Closes lid. At 18:00, Member 1 enters kitchen. Member 1 says: 'Need help?' Member 2 replies: 'Yes, stir this.' Member 1 stirs pan. Member 2 checks rice cooker. Member 2 adds spices. Member 1 tastes. Member 2 turns off induction cooker.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with Member 1 while listening to music on the phone (joint activity)
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table with Member 1. Serves food onto plates. Picks up fork. Eats. Member 1 says: 'This is good.' Member 2 replies: 'Thanks.' Picks up phone. Opens music app. Selects song. Puts phone down. Continues eating. Drinks water.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the counter and loading the dishwasher together with Member 1 (joint activity)
enriched_activities.desc: Clears dishes from table. Scrapes food into bin. Rinses dishes. Opens dishwasher. Loads dishes. Member 1 adds detergent. Member 2 closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Wipes counter with cloth. Member 1 says: 'I'll dry the pots.' Member 2 nods. Puts cloth away.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with Member 1 to unwind (joint activity)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa with Member 1. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Browses channels. Selects show. Watches TV. Member 1 says: 'This is interesting.' Member 2 nods. Adjusts volume. Watches more. Member 1 laughs. Member 2 smiles. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Watches TV. Turns off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Daily stretching and gentle mobility work adapted for reduced manual dexterity
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Lays out mat. Sits on mat. Does gentle neck rolls. Does shoulder stretches. Does wrist stretches with slow movements. Does leg stretches. Uses strap for assisted stretch. Rolls up mat. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Sketching and drawing with music playing
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Takes sketchbook and pencil. Sits on sofa. Turns on music. Opens sketchbook. Sketches lines. Shades areas. Erases. Sharpens pencil. Continues drawing. Turns page. Draws new sketch. Adds details. Closes sketchbook. Turns off music.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal journaling and evening prayer and reflection
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to study. Sits at desk. Opens journal. Picks up pen. Writes. Pauses. Writes more. Closes journal. Puts pen down. Folds hands. Closes eyes. Prays. Opens eyes. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Streaming YouTube videos and replying to messages on WhatsApp
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up phone. Opens YouTube. Selects video. Watches. Scrolls to next video. Watches more. Opens WhatsApp. Reads messages. Types reply. Sends. Watches another video. Types another message. Sends. Puts phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a low-caffeine herbal tea and preparing tomorrow's meals
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Takes tea bag. Places in cup. Pours hot water. Steeps. Takes containers. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Places in containers. Closes containers. Puts containers in refrigerator.

enriched_activities.activity: Night washing up and brushing teeth (after Member 1's 22:00-22:30 evening wash)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts water temperature. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Wipes face. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with a book, turning off the light at midnight to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Changes into pajamas. Gets into bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads. Turns page. Reads more. Closes book. Puts book on nightstand. Turns off light. Lies down. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket up. Breathes slowly.
